question: What real platform evidence is required before accepting the rewritten Windows process-tree cleanup path?
rationale: Mocked tests cover the intended branches, but they cannot settle real Windows process ancestry, helper hangs, PID reuse, and close-event ordering; the PR itself identifies Crabbox verification as an outstanding gate.

options.title: Require live platform proof
options.body: Require a redacted Windows or Crabbox transcript covering a termination-helper failure or hang and confirming bounded cleanup without unrelated-process termination.

options.title: Accept mocked coverage
options.body: Merge after ordinary CI based on the focused mocked Windows suite, explicitly accepting residual real-platform cleanup risk.

recommendation.title: Require live platform proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted Windows or Crabbox transcript covering a termination-helper failure or hang and confirming bounded cleanup without unrelated-process termination.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member authored the complete hardening sequence and can most directly produce or coordinate the intended Crabbox evidence.
